meta.title: 修图师的尽头是干保洁？

scenes.context: 开场：钢笔点落在腋窝附近，对应标题里的「保洁」隐喻——先打扫皮肤局部。修图先处理最细小的皮肤瑕疵，像打扫房间一样。
sentences: 钢笔点在腋窝附近，隐喻保洁。
The pen lands near the armpit—the cleaning metaphor.
Tidy a patch of skin first.
scenes.speak: The pen lands near the armpit—the cleaning metaphor. Tidy a patch of skin first.

scenes.context: 笑口特写；标题栏可见「变色鱼——高低频」，进入皮肤/牙齿细节层。高低频分离皮肤纹理与颜色，分别处理。
sentences: A smile close-up enters the detail layer.
高低频分别处理纹理与颜色。
High/low frequency splits texture from color.
scenes.speak: A smile close-up enters the detail layer. High/low frequency splits texture from color.

scenes.context: 地砖「扫地」：钢笔路径框住斜向路面区域，准备清理。把背景里的杂物当作垃圾，逐一扫除。
sentences: 钢笔路径框住路面区域。
A pen path selects the pavement area.
Ready to clean up the background clutter.
scenes.speak: A pen path selects the pavement area. Ready to clean up the background clutter.

scenes.context: 中景：电瓶车、车牌与钢笔路径同框，背景「清场」开始。背景里的车、牌都是干扰元素，需要清除。
sentences: A scooter and plate share the frame.
scenes.speak: A scooter and plate share the frame. The background cleanup begins.

scenes.context: 变换框罩住车牌/车轮一带；红门「福」字与「颜值修图」水印可见。用变换工具直接覆盖掉车牌等干扰。
sentences: 变换框罩住车牌和车轮。
A transform box covers the plate and wheel.
红门「福」字是保留的主体。
The red door's 福 stays as the subject.
scenes.speak: A transform box covers the plate and wheel. The red door's 福 stays as the subject.

scenes.context: 脚后跟创可贴特写——典型「保洁」级细节，准备擦掉。连脚后跟的创可贴都要修掉，这就是「保洁」级细节。
sentences: 脚后跟创可贴也要修掉。
Even the heel band-aid gets erased.
scenes.speak: Even the heel band-aid gets erased. That's cleaning-grade detail.

scenes.context: 中景验收：背景更干净，人物与红门「福」成为主体。清完背景，人物和「福」字成为画面焦点。
sentences: A cleaner background lets the subject stand out.
The person and 福 become the focus.
scenes.speak: A cleaner background lets the subject stand out. The person and 福 become the focus.

scenes.context: 终帧：清场后的彩色全景，对应「保洁」完成的结果。全部清理完成，画面干净，氛围还在。
sentences: A colorful wide shot after the cleanup.
scenes.speak: A colorful wide shot after the cleanup. Cleaning done—the frame is spotless.

practice: Retouching is housekeeping—tidy one patch at a time.
High/low frequency splits texture from color for clean skin.
Background clutter gets swept like a floor.
Band-aids and plates are cleaning-grade details.
A clean wide shot is the final acceptance.
pitfalls: Local, frequency-separated work keeps skin real.
Cars, plates and signs all get swept.
A heel band-aid is exactly the point.
Check tonal quality on its own.
The clean full frame is the acceptance.
shifts: 用 frequency separation（高低频）、pen path（钢笔路径）、local retouch（局部修图）
用 cleanup（清场）、sweep（清扫）、remove clutter（去杂物）
footer_notes: 转录基于图文实录完整口播与图注。已校正：开场钢笔点落在腋窝附近对应标题保洁隐喻先打扫皮肤局部、笑口特写标题栏可见变色鱼高低频进入皮肤牙齿细节层、地砖扫地钢笔路径框住斜向路面区域准备清理、中景电瓶车车牌与钢笔路径同框背景清场开始、变换框罩住车牌车轮一带红门福字与颜值修图水印可见、脚后跟创可贴特写典型保洁级细节准备擦掉、中景验收背景更干净人物与红门福成为主体、终帧清场后的彩色全景对应保洁完成的结果。
